- Share a summary PDF of the SOC 2 scope and the standard bridge language we use.

Can you confirm: (1) who at Novara should receive the portal invite (names + emails), and (2) if you have an NDA or redline requirements that would block delivering the full report? If you prefer, we can provision a limited view in the portal and require an NDA to download the full report.

Thanks,

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Post-demo recap — SOC 2 artifacts, bridge attestation, and next steps

Elena — thanks for the questions, and happy to take point on the portal/attestation work. Summary answers below, plus the immediate actions we’ll take:

High-level answers:
- SOC 2 Type II: Redwood’s most recent Type II report covers our hosted inference control environment for the period 2028-01-01 to 2028-06-30 and includes controls over system access, change management, logging/monitoring, and encryption.
- Logs/retention: We retain system and audit logs for a rolling 12 months by default; retention can be extended on Dedicated/Private deployments per contract.
- Encryption: Data at rest is encrypted (AES-256) and in-transit using TLS 1.3. Key management integrates with customer KMS for Private deployments when required.

What we’ll do now:
1) I will provision read-only access to the Redwood Trust Portal for elena.park@novarahealth.com and chris.holt@novarahealth.com and send credentials via secure link.
2) I’m attaching a short bridging attestation (redwood_bridge_attestation.docx) that summarizes coverage and the dates; it’s intended to bridge the gap between report releases.
3) We can accept the DDQ via email attachment or you can upload it into the portal — whichever is easier for your team.

Note on the full report: If Novara requires a downloadable copy of the full SOC 2 report, we typically execute an NDA before release. The portal can be used to review the report without an NDA. If you need a copy to be downloaded, please route an executed NDA to legal@redwood.com.

I’ll send the portal invites within the next 24–48 hours and will include a short walkthrough link.

Ben Carter
Head of Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
Attachment: redwood_bridge_attestation.docx (bridging attestation, one page)

Elena / team — thanks for sending the DDQ. Quick update and next steps so you can plan:

- Portal invite: Ben has provisioned read-only access; you should get secure invites to elena.park@novarahealth.com and chris.holt@novarahealth.com within the hour. The portal contains the SOC 2 summary, the bridge attestation, and a limited view of evidence artefacts.
- DDQ: Ben will fill what we can from the portal and our notes; we’ll flag any items that need legal input (e.g., downloadable copy of the full report).
- Keys / KMS: For hosted Redwood, we offer encryption with our managed keys by default. Customer-managed KMS integration is available on Private deployments and in Dedicated with specific configuration — we’ll note that in the DDQ response.
- Evidence extracts: We can provide anonymized sample log extracts in the portal review. If you need raw extracts for your audit, we’ll need to scope and schedule an evidence handoff.

Next step: Let’s schedule a 30-minute session on Mon, Jul 15 to walk through the portal and the attestation language — does 10:00 AM PT work for you?

If that works, I’ll send a calendar invite.
